text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Namibian President Sam Nujoma officially opened the 1997 Southern African Development Community consultative conference saying the region can only maximise its gains from global trade liberalisation through increased competitiveness.
- Transnamib has confirmed reports that the national airline Air Naimbia is in financial crisis and will seek strategic alliances with other regional and international carriers.
- The official opening of the 1997 SADC Consultative Conference in Windhoek was marked by calls for immediate action to avoid the region's slide into an economic wilderness.
- German defence minister Volker Ruhe arrives for a brief visit in Namibia on Monday where he is scheduled to meet President Sam Nujoma and Prime Minister Hage Geingob before flying to South Africa.
